title: Recommendations and unclear explanations
summary: This topic mostly captures fragments about telling others or being unable to explain features, with positive comments tied to recommendations and negative comments tied to confusion or intrusive driver prompts.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention recommending the car to others or being pleased enough to suggest it despite the topic wording being broad.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe not recommending the model, not being able to explain how features work, or disliking the car telling the driver how to drive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are dominated by partial or context-poor uses of words like tell and others, so their sentiment and exact aspect are often unclear.

limitations: The keyword cluster is broad and mixes recommendation language with unrelated uses of words like tell, others, and characteristics.
Most sampled fragments are too short or incomplete to identify a clear aspect or sentiment beyond the presence of the cluster terms.
The examples are stratified samples rather than representative estimates of how often these themes appear in all reviews.
